name: Novice aux cordes
design: Young adult male, lean and long-limbed, rounded pale mottled cranial dome, six thick short tendrils falling to shoulders, four fleshy facial mandibles plainly spread enough to read. High-collared sleeveless charcoal canvas tunic over a long-sleeved brown undershirt, narrow muted crimson sash, wrapped calves and simple claw-open foot bindings. Holds a compact coil of natural rope at one hip, opposite palm open at chest height; relaxed tilted shoulders. One small soft belt pouch, no armor.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE newly designed individual full-body 2D game sprite for Yautja: La Longue Chasse, HOMEWORLD APPRENTICE, a young ADULT novice (clearly adult proportions, not a child). Turn head in readable frontal three-quarter toward viewer with all four external appendages visible, jaw calmly slightly open, not a scream. Female individuals have equally alien Yautja four-mandible faces and modest functional garments, no human beauty features. Reference2 is an older role atlas, use ONLY bottom-row fourth character's simple charcoal tunic/red sash civilian apprentice clothing and realistic sprite rendering style, NEVER reproduce its flawed facial anatomy or other characters. A new distinct person per design: vary body silhouette, cranial proportions, scale mottling, thick tendril arrangement, garment construction, simple novice supplies and work pose. Simple practical cloth clothing with charcoal, brown and a muted red sash, little equipment, no elite armor, no advanced technology, no fantasy staff. Realistic handpainted high-detail 2D game sprite, slightly elevated three-quarter full body facing right; neutral diffuse illumination, not cartoon. ONE character with props only worn or hand-held. Actual transparent alpha background, no ground, cast shadow, atmosphere, halo, environment, photographic background or watermark. No image sheet, no extra subject, no written lettering. Do not reproduce source logo. Entire body with intact feet, head and all gear. AT LEAST 8% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON ALL FOUR SIDES; zoom out, character at most 80% canvas height.
